name: Qwen3.8 27B Q8_0 target-only on two Intel Arc Pro B70 cards

library.summary: Quality-conservative two-card llama.cpp/SYCL service with the lab's TP2, DP4A2, and recurrent-quad SG24 stack.

featured_metric.label: conventional decode median
featured_metric.scope: Historical reasoning-enabled 99-interval median across the accepted 12-prompt cache-zero suite; the packaged launcher defaults to reasoning off and is a distinct identity.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Qwen3.8 transfer, full B70 TP2 patch stack, DP4A2 by SG24 optimization, semantic and repeat gates, benchmarking, and packaging.
contributors.validated_effect: The accepted Qwen3.8 optimized lane measured 36.772932 versus 31.353431 tok/s for its matched runtime-base control (+17.285%), with 12/12 exact output hashes and cache-zero gates.

contributors.name: mndodd
contributors.contribution: Provided the optimized Intel SYCL llama.cpp fork used as the runtime base for the lab's Qwen Q8 TP2 work.
contributors.validated_effect: A separate matched Qwen3.6 Q8 TP2 A/B measured 31.338765 versus 29.610651 tok/s (+5.836%) for that base; this does not assign the later Qwen3.8 result to the fork.

project_patches.reason: The service and record depend on the lab's complete TP2/DP4A2 patch plus the Qwen3.8 recurrent-quad SG16 and SG24 increments.

commands.stop: Stop the foreground server with Ctrl-C, then verify clean teardown with pgrep -af llama-server.
